motion_guide_role: Native-authored colored limb ownership control; not final production art.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production PIXEL ART corgi-puppy trot sprite sheet, exactly4equalcolumns by2equalrows, eight successive poses in reading order. Input1 is the NEW APPROVED beautiful corgi DESIGN reference: preserve its charming head, large ears, white blaze/chest/socks, golden textured coat and upcurved fluffy tail. Input2 is an authored eight-pose MOTION CONTROL guide: faithfully render its leg placement in EVERY corresponding cell. Gray body is only pose control, restore the attractive full-color puppy from input1. Guide colors label persistent limb ownership: RED=near FRONT, GREEN=near HIND, BLUE=far FRONT, PURPLE=far HIND. Replace every guide color with the correct natural fur/white paw, no colored markers remain. Preserve exact complementary foot phases rather than copying one leg pose across cells. Red+purple are a diagonal pair; blue+green are the complementary pair.

Critical pose requirement: bottom-left frame4 GREEN near-hind guide leg is forward UNDER THE BELLY with a planted white paw, and RED near-front guide leg is bent BACK and lifted. That corresponding final puppy must show this same obvious opposite near-leg configuration. Top-left frame0 has the OPPOSITE diagonal: near FRONT white paw forward and grounded, near HIND paw bent back and lifted. These two main poses MUST be clearly different. All intermediate feet follow the matching guide. Real rounded paws, thick attached short legs with shoulder/hip anatomy, coherent textured fur and overlapping contours, no geometric stick legs or pasted textures.

Keep head/body/tail identical size and center in all8. Stable ground height in each cell, no second-row vertical offset. Entire puppy incl ears, tail, nose, tongue and all paws has generous transparent padding and never touches a cell boundary. Deliberate crisp square pixel clusters and clean stepped edges, designed for128x128logicalpixels perframe, not smooth painting or blurry pixel-filter artwork. Rich tasteful colors, no numerical color-count cap. Fully transparent negative space. No ground line, text, labels, arrows, diagram marks, drawn grid, cast shadows, backdrop or watermark. The final image is beautiful game-ready pixel animation art, not the colored control diagram.
note: Two unsuccessful private trials were rejected. The production source uses this guide-conditioned draft with explicit native retiming and finishing.
